Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent cinematic spacecraft sprite, StarChain enemy tier 7 "探路弦月舰"; 1536x1024 canvas preferred.
Primary request: A medium spacecraft with a unmistakable OPEN CRESCENT silhouette. Two sweeping curved silver blade arms extend forward toward LEFT, one upper arm and one lower arm, outlining a broad C shape that OPENS TO THE LEFT. The center-left negative space BETWEEN THE TWO ARMS stays fully open and transparent. A short central graphite-black engine spine joins the arms ONLY on the RIGHT convex back of the crescent. NO central pointed nose extending into the opening, no disk filling the opening. The two elegant curved arm tips are the forwardmost left points, separated vertically. Both arms are curved swept-forward blades, NOT straight triangular fighter wings. This is an open crescent spaceship, NOT a ring, saucer, plane or generic fighter.
Details: silver-white segmented armor along the curved upper surfaces, graphite inner mechanisms, restrained continuous violet edge strips following the curves, one small deep blue glass cockpit inset in the right-side central spine. A compact main engine at the RIGHT aft side with a short violet glow. No additional large protrusions. Medium-tier complexity and proportions, clean sharp silhouette.
Orientation and camera: forward direction LEFT, engine RIGHT, near-horizontal composition, cinematic three-quarter view from slightly above so that the crescent planform is very easy to read. Both forward blade tips remain visibly distinct.
Input image: reference ONLY for realistic cinematic silver-white armor/black machinery, blue glass, purple emissive accents and cool neutral top-left studio lighting. Do not copy reference's triangular fighter silhouette, big straight wings or dual-engine layout.
Framing: FULL BODY including arm tips and engine, nothing cropped. Keep ALL object and glow inside the central 78 percent of canvas width and central 78 percent of height, at least 8 percent clear transparent margin on every edge.
Style: high quality realistic hard surface sci-fi spacecraft render, precise armor plate seams, subtle edge wear and fine mechanical recesses. Clean dimensional cinematic lighting.
Background: TRUE transparent RGBA alpha, isolated spacecraft only. Clean transparent area through crescent opening and around it.
Avoid: closed ring, torus, saucer, triangular winged fighter, central long pointed fuselage, humanoid robot, humans, sea/land vehicles, background, opaque black backdrop, ground, cast shadow, environment fog, broad halo, long exhaust, laser beam, firing weapons, UI, text, numbers, letters, logo, watermark, border, multiple ships.
